description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions for handling release notes, Git commit data, and GitHub API interactions within the PyTorch project. It includes data structures for categorizing release notes, functions for parsing commit and PR information, and mechanisms for caching and retrieving commit data.

classes.name: CategoryGroup
classes.description: A data class representing a group of categories with a name and list of categories.

classes.name: _CommitDataCache
classes.description: A class for caching commit data to disk, with methods to read, write, and retrieve cached features.

methods.name: dict_to_features
methods.description: Converts a dictionary to a Features namedtuple.

methods.name: features_to_dict
methods.description: Converts a Features namedtuple to a dictionary.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its return code, stdout, and stderr.

methods.name: commit_body
methods.description: Retrieves the body of a commit message given its hash.

methods.name: commit_title
methods.description: Retrieves the title of a commit message given its hash.

methods.name: commit_files_changed
methods.description: Lists files changed in a commit given its hash.

methods.name: parse_pr_number
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from commit message body using regex.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Retrieves GitHub token from environment or config file.

methods.name: run_query
methods.description: Performs a GraphQL query to GitHub API.

methods.name: github_data
methods.description: Fetches labels, author, and accepters for a PR number from GitHub.

methods.name: get_features
methods.description: Gathers features for a commit, including PR info if available.

methods.name: get_commit_data_cache
methods.description: Returns a singleton cache object for commit data.
